n: Subcontractor is coded once, on 2 Code › Items, like every bucket – the separate “put each PO in a package” step is gone (a PO's package was always the PKG of its lines)
Reports › Rates › Subcontractor: the rate per unit by PO and month, grouped by the PKG on the items – read only
Monthly job: the same 4 steps as the menu, then “Export the monthly report”; the PO register has one home in Reports
Summary › Needs attention: indirect cost without a cost element (the “Other indirect” in the reports) is now listed first, with Code › to fix it
2 Code › POs: the codes come right after a wider Description, then To date and This month – as on Items
2 Code: the “Suggested because” column moved to the end of the row
DIV is dropped: a Subcontractor item is coded with PKG, MNL and cost element, like every other bucket – also gone from the PO screens and the Excel exports
2 Code: the code boxes come right after the description; To date and % follow them. % is the item's share of its type of works; the group row shows its share of all subcontractors
Narrower columns with short headers, and a wider Description so you see the service you are coding
2 Code is compact: the menu folds to the rail while you code (☰ opens it), the Items / SAP lines / POs switch sits in the toolbar, the keys are behind ⌨ Keys – about 50% more rows on screen
Subcontractor: the items to code are grouped by type of works, largest first – the code boxes, cost element included, now fit on the screen
The coding progress (… the next 10 items bring you to 80%) moved to the red line
2 Code: a line above the table says what is still empty in the bucket (e.g. cost element 97) – “Show the column ›” jumps to it
Clicking a code box selects the whole code, so what you type replaces it – no more mixed codes
One side panel at a time: Esc closes the Monthly job, and opening an item closes it; Undo also closes the “name the new PKG” question
One colour per bucket everywhere: the coloured square shows next to the bucket in Mapping rules, the PKG view of Expenses, the line drawers and the PKG summary items
GL list opens with “only GL with lines” ticked – untick it to see the whole SAP chart
GL list: every cost and revenue account of the SAP chart (260 GL), grouped by account group like the SAP tree – − / + folds a group
One line per GL: point at a name for its long text; the bucket shows as its colour square and name – click it to change
Filter by account group, or show only the GL with lines; the Excel export carries the account group and long name
WBS rules: the built-in WBS rows are editable too – pick another bucket or G&A group for Salaries · Wages · Bonus on that WBS; ↺ brings back the built-in
Your WBS rules: type the GL name the rule applies to (empty = every line on the WBS)
Mapping rules as lists: the GL list shows every GL with its bucket, G&A group and indirect code – change any of them in its box
Document types and WBS rules as tables you can change too; a bucket you change is kept as your rule and moves its lines at the next build (↻ Rebuild with your rules)
Indirect: each head in its colour with its cost elements, GLs and cost underneath · Special rules lists the few exceptions
Export to Excel starts with the GL list sheet
Page tabs: the amount sits beside the tab name, no more text running over it
Adjustment lines: the CJI3 + added − taken out = To date line is spaced and wraps on a narrow screen
